about: Feel the peak of cue sports in Pure Pool Pro, sequel to the acclaimed Pure Pool.

Experience stunning visuals at up to 8K native on PlayStation 5 Pro, high-fidelity reflections, and an enhanced physics engine tuned for lifelike spin, swerve, and shot control - delivering the most tactile, responsive, and satisfying cue sports…
Features Include: Cutting-Edge Visuals – Experience lifelike lighting, high-fidelity reflections, and intricate table and ball details that make every shot look and feel real.
Career Mode – Build your legacy by progressing through hundreds of events across US 8-Ball and US 9-Ball career modes.
Seamless Online Cross-Play – Compete in real-time matches with friends and rivals worldwide, no matter their platform. Rise to the top of global leaderboards.
Lifelike AI Opponents – Challenge 20 unique AI players, each with distinct personalities, signature cues, and adaptive strategies that keep you on your toes.
